verdict.rationale: The only retention evidence is fixed per-plan retention windows on the pricing page (3-day on Team, 7-day on Enterprise). That is a vendor-set limit tied to the plan tier, not a user-facing control over retention periods or data deletion. No evidence shows configurable retention policies, deletion APIs, or purge tooling, even for self-hosted deployments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
